@ What Are SQL Server Functions?
Imagine you’re a chef in a busy restaurant. Instead of chopping vegetables
every time you cook, you keep pre-cut veggies ready.
SQL Functions are like that—predefined, reusable blocks of code that save
time and effort!
Definition: Functions in SQL Server are database objects that accept parameters, perform
calculations/operations, and return a value or a table.
Purpose: Encapsulate logic for reuse, simplify complex queries, and improve performance. \
Presented By: Raghavendra Marakattu
(https://www.linkedin.com/in/raghavendra-marakattu-b0300113b/)

Code Reusability - Write once, use anywhere.
Simplified Queries - Break complex logic into manageable parts.
Consistency — Ensures the same logic is applied everywhere.
Performance — Can reduce redundant calculations.
Without Functions:
*Repeated code > Maintenance nightmare
*Harder debugging
*Slower performance due to redundant logic
